item.title: Episode 10 - What is the Manager's Mission?
item.description: A managers job should be very clear, but often companies promote key sales people into managerial roles without giving them the direction to grow their store or territory. Harry is going to define what the mission of a manager truly is and how they can achieve success in their role.

item.title: Episode 11: Why You Are Always Hiring | Retail Revisited with Harry J. Friedman
item.description: Hiring is often a reactive event based on immediate need, but it doesn’t need to be. Companies can start building their bench and plan for the known need of certain positions based on the historical turnover of that role. Harry gives some ideas and insights into being a culture of proactive hiring.

item.title: Episode 12: District Manager or District Menace?
item.description: This Podcast episode is about District Managers, or as Harry likes to refer to them sometimes, a District Menace. The truth is that very few understand what their true job really is. They're not firefighters running around putting out fires, they're partners, partners with the locations they manage. Their partnership is aligned with a common goal, to make sure that each location that they manage hits their sales targets.

item.title: Episode 13: Productivity Based Pay | Retail Revisited w/ Harry J. Friedman
item.description: Retail is a choice business, and salespeople have the choice to improve their sales skills, so shouldn't they be paid based on that choice?

item.title: Episode 14: Sales vs Operations | Retail Revisited with Harry J. Friedman
item.description: It's a constant battle. How does operations support sales and what's more important sales or operations? The reality is, operations becomes somewhat of a cornerstone to sales.
